model.rationale: Baltimore-area MD-07 leans heavily Democratic at D+31, and incumbent Kweisi Mfume holds a large financial edge over Scott Collier, who reports little fundraising. Markets price a Democratic win around 96%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: Any sign of a serious challenger fundraising surge or unexpected incumbent trouble would be the main thing to watch, though none is currently evident.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.

overview:
Maryland's 7th District, centered on Baltimore, is one of the most Democratic-leaning seats in the country, with a partisan lean of D+31. Incumbent Kweisi Mfume, first elected in 2020, is running for another term and has built a solid financial position with over $700,000 on hand. Republican Scott Collier has reported little fundraising activity, leaving him with few resources to compete.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, but prediction markets put the Democratic win probability around 96%. With the fundamentals, money, and market pricing all aligned, the seat is rated Safe Democratic.
